source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The feed display assertion expects webPageItem to be checked after selecting website display, but its failure text says Summary should be selected. The send-format helper expects its checked Boolean, but inserts not into the message when checked is true. Both mismatches remain in the fixed accepted source. Their messages need to describe the actual expected receiver/state; the source study did not execute either test or show a functional selection failure.
title: Two checked-state tests retain reversed or stale failure text
